name: braid
description: Headwaters: a Git platform for the agentic era, on Cloudflare Workers and Artifacts.

scripts.build: pnpm design:sync && pnpm patches:bundle && pnpm --filter @braid/ui build
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy:prod: wrangler deploy --domain braid.drp.icu && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Operator token for the admin API, the scripts (`pnpm seed:demo`, `pnpm smoke`) and app sign-in before Cloudflare Access. Use a long random string.

ARTIFACTS.description: Cloudflare Artifacts (open beta, Workers Paid). Every River, Channel and Confluence repo lives in the `braid` namespace.

DB.description: D1 index of Rivers, Intents, Channels, reviews, verdicts and Eddy cards.

BLOBS.description: R2: raw Artifacts events, test logs, transcripts, diffs and preview screenshots.

OAUTH_KV.description: OAuth 2.1 state for MCP clients that sign in (ChatGPT, claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, …).

EVENTS_QUEUE.description: Queue for account-level Artifacts events (created / forked / deleted / imported).
